title: AI SFX?
author: Calenart
selftext:
Hey there!  
Do you guys know any place I could find an AI generator (locally or not) that can make all sorts of SoundFX? I'm trying to find something free if possible.

replies.author: Technical_Ad_440
replies.body: would be great if it matched current paid ones unfortunately it isn't there yet.

comments.author: JakeQwayk
comments.body:
Or free you can use Unity (6.2 specifically has soundfx generator that’s is free to use) 
It’s in in open beta so they are testing it 

I have used it and found it to work very good
You can download the audio files too and use them elsewhere

comments.author: Bookoora
comments.body: What about one where I upload an image or video and a contextual sfx is generated?

replies.author: Calenart
replies.body: I think it's easier if you use ChatGPT or something to define a 'prompt to create a soundfx' based on your image.

comments.author: trekkerxxx
comments.body: Tunee! [https://www.tunee.ai/](https://www.tunee.ai/) Here's the music quality it has: [https://www.tunee.ai/project/SPbTha6qx20Be1Zix](https://www.tunee.ai/project/SPbTha6qx20Be1Zix)

replies.author: Calenart
replies.body: I mean... For music I'm using Suno AI. I want to make some sound effects. (gunshot, walking, car engine sound, etc.)

replies.author: Technical_Ad_440
replies.body: just use suno $30 10k credits 2k songs tunee is a fancy prompter charging $38 for 500 songs. at that point you prompt gemini for free and put it into suno for $30 and make the songs there

replies.author: Calenart
replies.body: I already have songs, I need sound effects.

replies.author: Calenart
replies.body: Btw, I have found Elevenlabs can do that, so I'm using it.
